skill.name: elderly-ui-audit
skill.description: Audit web and mobile interface code against Chinese elderly-friendly design standards, then produce a structured report and optional style-only fixes.
skill.summary: Check accessibility and elderly-friendly UI requirements for web and mobile projects.
skill.author: xuyuting133

security_audit.summary: All 58 static findings are false positives. The shell findings are Markdown formatting, the reconnaissance findings are static CSS, the network findings are documentation links, and the high-entropy files are readable reference standards. No prompt injection, credential collection, data exfiltration, or malicious execution intent was found.

remediation.issue: Automatic fixes can modify user style files.
remediation.suggestion: Keep explicit confirmation before every fix, show the exact file changes, and provide a reviewable diff or backup before writing.

remediation.issue: Static scanners misclassify Markdown code spans as shell execution.
remediation.suggestion: Avoid presenting unsupported command-line flags as executable commands, or label them clearly as conceptual future capabilities.

static_findings.snippet: <div style="margin-top:40px; padding-top:20px; border-top:1px solid #e9edf4; font-size:14px; color:#
- 检查是否存在 `package.json` 中的移动端框架(React Native、Flutter、uni-app)或 Web 框架(React、Vue、Angular)。
- 扫描 CSS 中的 `font-size`、`line-height`、`letter-spacing`、`margin`、`padding` 属性。
- 对于 Web,检查是否有 `font-size` 在 `@media` 或 `:root` 中的变量控制。
- 对于 App,检查样式文件中的 `fontSize`(RN)或 `textSize`(Flutter)。
- 提取所有 `color` 和 `background-color` 组合(或 `background`)。
- 检查是否存在仅通过 `color` 区分的状态(如红色表示错误,但无文字提示)。
- 扫描所有 `button`、`a`、`div[onClick]`、`TouchableOpacity` 等可交互元素。
- 检查其 `width`、`height`、`min-width`、`min-height`、`padding` 组合计算实际点击区域。
- 搜索手势相关代码(如 `onPan`、`onPinch`、`gesture` 等),检查是否超过 3 指。
- Web 检查是否有 `tabindex` 和键盘事件监听、`<video>/<audio>` 的键盘控制。
- 搜索 `setTimeout`/`setInterval` 触发的弹窗逻辑。
- 搜索验证码相关组件(`captcha`、`verification code`、`验证码`)。
- 检查是否有 `audio` 或 `alt` 文本替代。
- Web 检查验证码图片的 `width`/`height` 是否支持 ≥ 2倍放大。
- 搜索代码中的广告关键词:`ad`、`banner`、`promotion`、`sponsor`、`广告`。
- 检查是否存在 `setTimeout` 或 `setInterval` 触发的弹窗。
- 检查是否有 `accessibility` 相关属性的限制(如 `important-for-accessibility="no"` 或 `aria-hidden="true"` 滥用)。
- 检查 `package.json` 中的 `browserslist` 是否覆盖主流浏览器。
输出为独立的 HTML 文件,保存为 `elderly-audit-report.html`,用户可直接在浏览器中打开查看。
**使用方式**:Claude 在生成报告时,将上述模板中的数据(时间、数量、问题描述、代码定位等)替换为实际检测结果,保存为 `elderly-audit-report.html` 并告知用户文件路
- 保留原有样式作为注释备份(例如添加 `/* original: 16px */`)。
- 支持通过 `--fix` 参数直接执行自动修复。
- 支持 `--only` 指定只检测某一模块(如 `--only font`)。

content.value_statement: Accessibility gaps can make web and mobile products difficult for older adults to use. This skill reviews source code against Chinese elderly-friendly design standards and produces clear remediation guidance.
actual_capabilities: Identifies whether a project is a web site or mobile application.
Reviews typography, spacing, contrast, and color-only status signals.
Checks interaction targets, keyboard support, gestures, dialogs, and timed actions.
Reviews captcha alternatives, advertising risks, navigation, and assistive technology compatibility.
Generates a standalone HTML report with findings, code locations, and suggested changes.
Offers user-confirmed style-only fixes for selected typography, contrast, and spacing issues.
limitations: It cannot prove runtime behavior or visual rendering without manual testing.
Some requirements need product context, device testing, or human review.
Automatic fixes are limited to style values and can require design validation.
It is based on the cited Chinese standards and is not legal compliance advice.

use_cases.title: Review a public service website
use_cases.description: Find readability, contrast, keyboard, and navigation gaps before releasing an elderly-friendly web experience.

use_cases.title: Assess a mobile elder mode
use_cases.description: Check mobile interface targets, gestures, captions, and elder-mode entry points against the referenced app standard.

use_cases.title: Prepare a design remediation report
use_cases.description: Create a shareable HTML report that helps designers and developers prioritize accessibility improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Run a full audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this project for elderly-friendly UI compliance and create an HTML report. Ask before making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Check typography and contrast
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the CSS and components for elderly-friendly font sizes, spacing, and color contrast. Report only confirmed issues.

prompt_templates.title: Review mobile interactions
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this mobile application for touch target sizes, complex gestures, dialog controls, and assistive technology compatibility.

prompt_templates.title: Propose selective fixes
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this project, list safe style-only fixes for typography and contrast, and wait for my approval before editing any files.

output_examples.input: Audit the project and focus on typography and color contrast.
output: Typography: body text is below the target size in two style files.
Contrast: one button label does not meet the 4.5:1 target.
Next step: review the generated HTML report before applying style fixes.

output_examples.input: Check the elder mode of this mobile application.
output: Interaction: the primary action target is smaller than the recommended size.
Navigation: no clear elder-mode entry was found on the home screen.
Recommendation: validate fixes on a physical device with assistive technology enabled.

best_practices: Run the audit on a clean working tree and review the report with design stakeholders.
Validate findings with browser, device, keyboard, and assistive technology testing.
Approve each automatic fix only after reviewing its exact style changes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat static code checks as proof of full accessibility compliance.
Do not apply automatic fixes without reviewing visual and product effects.
Do not use the report as a substitute for legal, usability, or device testing.

faq.question: Which projects can this skill review?
faq.answer: It is designed for web projects and mobile applications with accessible source files.

faq.question: Which standards does it reference?
faq.answer: It references the Chinese internet website and mobile application elderly-friendly design standards listed in the skill.

faq.question: Does it modify files automatically?
faq.answer: It should ask for confirmation before applying style-only automatic fixes.

faq.question: What does the report contain?
faq.answer: The report summarizes checks, findings, code locations, and suggested remediations.

faq.question: Can it verify every accessibility requirement?
faq.answer: No. Runtime behavior, device differences, and usability still require manual validation.

faq.question: Can it be used in a delivery workflow?
faq.answer: Yes. Use its report as an engineering review artifact, then validate results in your test environment.
